questions.q: You must summarise the benefits of urban gardens. Which should you include?
options: A teacher's quotation copied from the text
The criticism about lack of water
A relevant benefit, in your own words
An opening: «En este texto el autor habla de…»
questions.why: Only relevant points, reworded; no quotations, off-focus points or introductions.

questions.q: The most concise way to summarise «correr, nadar e ir en bicicleta» is:
options: correr, nadar e ir en bicicleta
questions.why: A general word (hypernym) replaces a list of examples.

questions.q: Which format is correct for the summary?
options: An introduction, the ideas and a personal conclusion
Notes with quotations from the text
Continuous prose, ideas linked, no opinion
questions.why: The summary is continuous, neutral prose; lists and opinions lower the mark.

questions.q: Rewrite concisely in your own words: «Las personas que caminan todos los días sufren menos problemas de corazón y además duermen mejor por la noche.»
questions.model: Caminar a diario protege el corazón y mejora el descanso.
points: own words, shorter than the original
